svg.title: What students want schools to do about AI. AI Vanguard 2025 Student AI Policy Survey, 447 responses.
svg.desc: Horizontal bar chart. Teach students to use AI responsibly, 74 percent, 330 of 447. Involve students in shaping AI rules and policies, 35 percent, 158. Create stricter rules to limit misuse, 26 percent, 116. Allow free use with minimal restrictions, 24 percent, 106. Do nothing, AI use should be up to individuals, 14 percent, 63. AI should complete most of the work, 5 percent, 22. Select-all-that-apply, so bars total more than 100 percent. Fielded August 25 to December 17, 2025 at six Southern California high schools.
svg.text: What students want schools to do about AI
“What role should schools play in guiding AI use?” Select all that apply. Share of all 447 responses.

g.text: Teach students how to use AI responsibly
Involve students in shaping AI rules and policies
Create stricter rules to limit misuse
Allow free use with minimal restrictions
Do nothing; AI use should be up to individuals
AI should complete most of the work

svg.text: Source: AI Vanguard, 2025 Student AI Policy Survey. 447 responses, six Southern California high schools, Aug 25 – Dec 17, 2025. Convenience sample; not representative.
Methods, exact wording, and counts: aivanguard.org/research/student-ai-survey
